feature: User-started iPhone and iPad recording through screen lock

scenarios.name: Keep established microphone capture through background and Stop explicitly
scenarios.given: the user has started listening on iPhone or iPad and capture is recording
scenarios.when: the screen locks or the app backgrounds, speech arrives, and the user later presses Stop
scenarios.then: the same capture and elapsed start remain active, finalized speech is saved, foreground return creates no second run, and Stop remains terminal; background alone never starts an idle microphone or completes a cancelled preparation; an inactive interruption-end stays stopped with recovery guidance and never falsely claims resumption

manual.reason: Simulator session transitions do not establish microphone and native speech continuity while a physical device is locked.
steps: On supported iPhone and iPad, start in the foreground, confirm Listening, lock the screen beyond the normal suspension interval, provide known speech, unlock and verify all words and continuous saved-audio time when opted in.
Repeat with the on-device fallback speech module where available, interruption/route failure and explicit Stop; record device, OS, source and real outcomes.

scenarios.name: Background speech preserves opt-in audio and suspends auxiliary AI
scenarios.given: an established microphone recording has optional audio saving and automatic summary choices
scenarios.when: the screen locks and capture continues without model passes
scenarios.then: only opted-in audio keeps writing, no new automatic provider request starts, and speaker audio stays bounded without dropping transcription input; active return can catch up under current choices

scenarios.name: Suspend auxiliary models and invalidate late output before the app leaves active use
scenarios.given: a user-started recording has automatic summaries, speech correction or speaker work queued or in flight
scenarios.when: the app becomes inactive or backgrounds, then returns active
scenarios.then: capture continues but no new auxiliary provider or speaker work starts, cancelled old output cannot publish, the current speaker run and identities survive, and only current foreground work resumes; queued manual/selection/title requests cannot start after suspension, held titles cannot rename any conversation, and vocabulary classification is cancelled and not scheduled by background speech

scenarios.name: Explain continued recording and preserve the rendered Stop control across background return
scenarios.given: a user has started listening in the iPhone or iPad interface
scenarios.when: the app actually backgrounds and returns to the foreground, then the user taps Stop
scenarios.then: Listening and Stop still represent the same recording, a concise notice explains continued capture with optional AI paused, and explicit Stop returns to an enabled Start control; the simulator fixture does not capture real audio

scenarios.name: Reach current summaries while the recording disclosure uses portrait space
scenarios.given: an iPhone is recording in portrait with its screen-lock disclosure and a long conversation or provisional live speech
scenarios.when: the user scrolls the actual Quick reading area or selects Summary and generates an answer before and after final recognition
scenarios.then: Quick remains reachable without Refresh and publishes Monday and Sarah while the backlog still says Catching up; Summary is actually selected with its generation control visible, the first answer marks recognition provisional, and final recognition removes that marker without losing the answer

scenarios.name: Keep the landscape Duo recording workspace and Stop usable with the screen-lock notice
scenarios.given: an iPhone has established recording in portrait and shows the continued-recording disclosure; the synthetic QA probe overlays the view without reserving production workspace or intercepting controls
scenarios.when: the device rotates to landscape and the user stops recording
scenarios.then: the actual transcript and Quick panels remain side by side in Duo with usable transcript/model controls, the disclosure remains accessible, and explicit Stop returns to enabled Start without a second recording
